title: Mashle: Magic and Muscles
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world where social rank depends on magic, Mash Burnedead has none, only enormous physical strength. To protect a quiet life with his adoptive father, he enrolls at Easton Magic Academy and aims for the elite title of Divine Visionary, solving magical problems with muscle.
life_message: A good life means protecting family and friends through effort, whatever rank society assigns you.

delivery.note: The anti-hierarchy message is delivered through comedy and fights; status-obsessed elites serve mostly as comic obstacles.

winners_losers: The magicless outsider and his friends beat a hierarchy that ranks people by inborn magic; status-obsessed elites lose. Sympathy goes to loyalty and effort over rank.
